in_marathi.name: Bhavyasree
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhavyasree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhavyasree is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘bhavya’ meaning prosperous or auspicious, and ‘sree’ meaning goddess or wealth. This name is often given to a girl born into a prosperous family or to one who is expected to bring prosperity and good fortune to her family.
